purpose: causal/mechanistic decomposition of the V2 Mahalanobis-FAIL / EDL-PASS specificity contradiction into generic Evidence-presence/distribution bias, representation/processing effects, and final readout effects. NOT detector selection.

frozen_populations.rk_rows: frozen eval parquet recoverable==1 AND is_unknown==0 (Credential 2688 / Recon_Scanning 1005 / Web_Injection 1874)
frozen_populations.tu_rows: frozen eval parquet is_unknown==1 (8000 per rotation)
frozen_populations.edl_train_population: same frozen TRAIN pool, FIT/EARLY_STOP split, Known-only

conditions.REAL: true legal T/R Evidence, deployed masks
conditions.NULL_PRESENT: availability mask present, Evidence block = all-zero neutral vector in the frozen log1p transform space
conditions.SHUFFLED: deterministic permutation of T/R blocks within rotation/seed/eval population/block type; RK and TU shuffled separately; masks unchanged; offline mechanism control only

metrics.gain: score_B - score_s (novelty scores, higher = more novel; positive = moved toward Known)
metrics.effect_ratios: NULL_TO_REAL and SHUFFLED_TO_REAL for RK and TU (signed, pooled, denominator REAL)
metrics.bootstrap: 1000 rotation-stratified sample replicates, seeded, 2.5/97.5 percentile 95% CIs

identity_checks.real_reproduces_validation: REAL-condition Mahalanobis gains must reproduce the persisted V2 validation same_sample_comparison values within 1e-6
identity_checks.edl_sanity: alpha >= 1 everywhere; loss decreases over steps (V1 section 12)
identity_checks.shuffled_preserves_marginals: shuffled block mean/std equal original within 1e-9

same_representation_test.readout_b: one fixed Dirichlet head trained on frozen h only; exact V2 EDL semantics (Type-II ML + fixed KL 0.1, AdamW 3e-4/1e-4, 20 epochs, patience 3, Known-only fit/calib); trunk fully frozen; no tuning
same_representation_test.valid: V1 EDL sanity checks pass; else STOP_NEEDS_REVIEW for this subtest
same_representation_test.contradiction_reproduced_rule: Mahalanobis gap negative AND EDL-head gap positive on same h in >= 2/3 rotations (3/3 = broadly)

reverse_crosscheck.status: AVAILABLE (frozen EDL trunk_forward is the natural penultimate representation; no redesign)
reverse_crosscheck.procedure: retrain B_EDL with exact frozen V2 recipe (seed 20260817); fit per-state Mahalanobis geometry on its TRAIN FIT Known h_EDL; compute gains/gaps on same RK/TU rows

quantities: total evidence S = sum(alpha) (= Dirichlet strength)
top expected prob p_top = max(alpha)/S (= top-class evidence concentration by Dirichlet identity)
edl_mechanism_diagnostics.comparison: RK vs True Unknown, per rotation and pooled, deltas after - before

interpretation.readout_dominant_support: same frozen h shows Mahalanobis-negative / EDL-positive specificity contradiction in >= 2/3 rotations
interpretation.presence_bias_support: pooled NULL_TO_REAL ratio >= 0.5 (RK or TU) with CI lower >= 0.3
interpretation.distribution_bias_support: pooled SHUFFLED_TO_REAL ratio >= 0.5 (RK or TU) with CI lower >= 0.3
interpretation.content_signal_support: REAL gap > NULL gap AND REAL gap > SHUFFLED gap (pooled), paired CI lower > 0 on both differences
interpretation.representation_dominant_support: rule 1 fails and Mahalanobis-on-EDL-representation flips/materially changes the primary gap (CI-separated)
interpretation.consequence_rule: if only that EDL is a generally stronger detector is shown (no fixed-representation contradiction, no content signal), state that the recovery-aware novelty innovation hypothesis is weakened
